title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry
description: One row per bundled photo in a SiteShrimp CONQUAS / Photos ZIP export. Pairs an ISO 19650-aligned filename with the originating defect's metadata so reviewers and downstream tools (BIM viewers, ACC engines, audit pipelines) can validate or ingest without bespoke parsing.
x-csv-header-convention: Each property maps 1:1 to a column in the Entries sheet of _manifest.xlsx (or _entries.csv fallback). The 'x-csv-header' field on each property is the exact column header string. Consumers parsing the workbook should use the header row as the key source and normalise to the property names below.
x-i18n-convention: Storage values are English by design — controlled vocabularies (severity, status, conquas_element, entry_type, …) are STABLE on the wire so downstream parsers, ACC engines, and BIM tooling can rely on a fixed vocabulary across all locales. Display localisation is the consumer's responsibility, resolved against lang/<code>.json (23 locales). Properties MAY carry an 'x-i18n' object with locale-keyed alternates for display-only fields (x-csv-header, description); enum *values* are NEVER translated.

x-changelog.1.1.0: Additive: gps_lat, gps_lng, drawing_id, drawing_page, pin_x, pin_y, media_hash, created_at, ai_confidence, ai_model, ai_prompt_version, human_reviewed, field_provenance. No breaking changes; all new fields optional.
x-changelog.1.2.0: Additive: x-jsonld-context IRI pointers on every property; x-jsonld-context-convention top-level docs. JSONL serialisation now supported in photo ZIP export (_entries.jsonl). No breaking changes.

filename.description: ZIP-relative path to the bundled photo. Example: 'Floor/PROJ-ORIG-MMP-FLOOR-001.jpg'.

iso_19650_filename.description: Canonical ISO 19650-aligned filename for this evidence asset. Stable across exports; the ISO-CONQUAS naming anchor.

conquas_element.description: CONQUAS Internal Finishes element, derived from the defect's component. 'Other' covers non-IF components (structural, external, infra, safety). Empty when no derivation is possible.

folder.description: Bucket name in the ZIP. Derived from the chosen grouping scheme (CONQUAS element / severity / status / trade / component / area).

entry_id.description: SiteShrimp defect identifier. Stable across exports.

description.description: Defect description text (free text or AI-prefilled). Note: this property is named 'description' to match the column; not to be confused with this JSON Schema metadata 'description' field.

component.description: Component label. Stored in English; consumers may apply locale mapping via lang/<code>.json.

issue.description: Issue label. Stored in English; consumers may apply locale mapping via lang/<code>.json.

date.description: Defect creation date in YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601, date-only). For the full ISO timestamp with timezone see 'created_at'. Empty when unknown.

due_date.description: Optional due date in YYYY-MM-DD (ISO 8601). Empty when not set.

source_filename.description: Original camera-capture filename before ISO 19650 renaming. Empty for older entries that pre-date the iso_filename feature.

gps_lat.description: Defect's primary latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Empty when no GPS captured. Populated from the defect's parsed coordinates when present.

gps_lng.description: Defect's primary longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Empty when no GPS captured.

drawing_id.description: Identifier of the linked drawing for the defect's first pin, if any. Defects with multiple pins surface only the first; the full pin set is available via the REPORT export.

drawing_page.description: PDF page number of the linked drawing for the defect's first pin (1-based). Empty when no pin.

pin_x.description: Normalised X coordinate of the first pin on the drawing (0–1). Empty when no pin.

pin_y.description: Normalised Y coordinate of the first pin on the drawing (0–1). Empty when no pin.

media_hash.description: Hash of the photo bytes. Used by SiteShrimp for ISO 19650 filename derivation and dedup; downstream consumers can use it for tamper-evidence and idempotent ingestion.

created_at.description: Full ISO 8601 timestamp (with timezone offset) when the defect was logged. The 'date' column is a YYYY-MM-DD truncation kept for back-compat and human reading. Empty when unknown.

ai_confidence.description: Per-row AI confidence score (0.0–1.0) when fields were AI-prefilled. Empty for human-only entries. Lets ACC pipelines threshold rows for auto-accept vs human-review queues.

ai_model.description: Model identifier that produced the AI-prefilled fields (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-7'). Empty for human-only entries. Lets pipelines correlate output quality with model version.

ai_prompt_version.description: Version tag of the prompt used (semver, commit SHA, or schema version). Lets downstream pipelines correlate output drift with prompt changes.

human_reviewed.description: True when a human edited or signed off on the AI-prefilled fields after capture. False/empty when the row is AI-only and unreviewed.

field_provenance.description: Optional per-field source map indicating which fields came from the AI vs the human, e.g. {"severity":"ai","title":"human"}. Serialised as a JSON-encoded string in CSV/xlsx; surfaced as an object in JSON consumers.

x-jsonld-context-convention: Each property MAY carry an x-jsonld-context field with a candidate IRI for JSON-LD generation. Namespaces: geo: <http://www.w3.org/2003/01/geo/wgs84_pos#>, dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>, schema: <https://schema.org/>, siteshrimp: <https://siteshrimp.org/vocab/>. The siteshrimp: namespace is provisional; the IFC + regulatory parsing app may co-design a stable vocabulary with the SiteShrimp team — bumps go in x-changelog.
